nodes.name: Lemma 49
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$. If $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}}$, then $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}}$ for all DAGs $\mathcal{D} \in [\mathcal{G}]$.

nodes.name: Lemma 48
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G}= (\mathbf{V,E})$, and let $\mathcal{D}$ be a DAG in $[\mathcal{G}]$. Additionally, let $\overline{p}$ be a path in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}$ from $\mathbf{Z}$ to $\mathbf{Y}$ such that $\overline{p}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$ but no subsequence of $\overline{p}$ in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$. Then the sequence of nodes in $\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}}$ corresponding to $\overline{p}$ forms a path where a node is a definite non-collider or collider if and only if it is a non-collider or collider, respectively, on $\overline{p}$.

nodes.name: Lemma 51
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$. If $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}}$, then $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}}$ for all DAGs $\mathcal{D} \in [\mathcal{G}]$.

nodes.name: Lemma 50
nodes.statement:
Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$ and let $\mathcal{D}$ be a DAG in $[\mathcal{G}]$. Additionally, let $\overline{p} = \langle Z=V_1, \dots, V_k=Y \rangle$, $Z \in \mathbf{Z}$, $Y \in \mathbf{Y}$, $k > 1$, be a proper path from $\mathbf{Z}$ to $\mathbf{Y}$ in ${\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}}$ such that $\overline{p}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$ and no subsequence of $\overline{p}$ in ${\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$. Let $p^*$ be the corresponding path in $\mathcal{G}$. 
    \begin{enumerate}[label = (\roman*)]
        \item
        If $\mathcal{G}$ has no edge $Z - V_i$, $i \in \{2, \dots, k\}$, then the sequence of nodes in $\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}$ corresponding to $\overline{p}$ forms a path where a node is a definite non-collider or collider if and only if it is a non-collider or collider, respectively, on $\overline{p}$.

        \item 
        If $\mathcal{G}$ has an edge $Z - V_i$, $i \in \{2, \dots, k\}$, let $V_i$ be the closest such node to $Y$ on $p^*$. Then the sequence of nodes in $\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}$ corresponding to $\langle Z, V_i \rangle \oplus \overline{p}(V_i, Y)$ forms a path where a node is a definite non-collider or collider if and only if it is a non-collider or collider, respectively, on $\overline{p}$.
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 54
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$. If $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X \, Z'(W)}}}}$, then $(\mathbf{Z} \perp_{d} \mathbf{Y} |\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W})_{\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X \, Z(W)}}}}$ for all DAGs $\mathcal{D} \in [\mathcal{G}]$, where we define $\mathbf{Z'(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{PossAn}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{G}_{\mathbf{V \setminus X}})$ and $\mathbf{Z(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{An}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 53
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X,Y,Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$ and let $\mathcal{D}$ be a DAG in $[\mathcal{G}]$. Define $\mathbf{Z(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{An}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}})$. Then let $\overline{p}$ be a proper path from $\mathbf{Z}$ to $\mathbf{Y}$ in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X \, Z(W)}}}$ such that $\overline{p}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$ but no subsequence of $\overline{p}$ in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X \, Z(W)}}}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$. Define $\mathbf{Z'(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{PossAn}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{G}_{\mathbf{V \setminus X}})$. Then the sequence of nodes in $\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X \, Z'(W)}}}$ corresponding to $\overline{p}$ forms a path where a node is a definite non-collider or collider if and only if it is a non-collider or collider, respectively, on $\overline{p}$.

nodes.name: Lemma 52
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G} = (\mathbf{V,E})$ and let $\mathcal{D}$ be a DAG in $[\mathcal{G}]$. Define $\mathbf{Z(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{An}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}})$ and $\mathbf{Z'(W)} = \mathbf{Z} \setminus \mathrm{PossAn}(\mathbf{W}, \mathcal{G}_{\mathbf{V \setminus X}})$. Then $\mathbf{Z'(W)} \subseteq \mathbf{Z(W)}$.

nodes.name: Lemma 18
nodes.statement:
{\normalfont (Lemma 3.2 of [perkovic2017interpreting])}
    Let $X$ and $Y$ be nodes in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G}$ and let $p$ be a path from $X$ to $Y$ in $\mathcal{G}$. If there exists a DAG $\mathcal{D} \in [\mathcal{G}]$ such that the path in $\mathcal{D}$ corresponding to $p$ in $\mathcal{G}$ is causal, then $p$ is possibly causal.

nodes.name: Theorem 6
Lemma 44
nodes.statement:
{\normalfont (cf. Lemma 1 of [zhang2006causal])}
    Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a DAG $\mathcal{D}=(\mathbf{V,E})$, and let $\mathcal{G}$ be an MPDAG such that $\mathcal{D} \in [\mathcal{G}]$. Additionally, let $p$ be a path in $\mathcal{D}$ from $\mathbf{Z}$ to $\mathbf{Y}$ such that $p$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$ but no subsequence of $p$ in $\mathcal{D}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$. Then the following hold.
    \begin{enumerate}[label=(\roman*)]
        \item
        All colliders on $p$ are unshielded.
        
        \item
        The path in $\mathcal{G}$ corresponding to $p$ is of definite status.
    \end{enumerate}

nodes.name: Lemma 45
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X}$ and $\mathbf{W}$ be disjoint node sets in a DAG $\mathcal{D}$ that has no edges into $\mathbf{X}$. If a path in $\mathcal{D}$ is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$, then it does not contain nodes in $\mathbf{X}$ and is d-connecting given $\mathbf{W}$.

nodes.name: Lemma 46
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X}$, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\mathbf{Z}$, and $\mathbf{W}$ be pairwise disjoint node sets in a DAG $\mathcal{D}$, let $p$ be a path in $\mathcal{D}$ from $\mathbf{Z}$ to $\mathbf{Y}$ that is d-connecting given $\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}$, and let $q$ be a subsequence of $p$ in $\mathcal{D}$. Then all colliders on $q$ are in $\mathrm{An}(\mathbf{X} \cup \mathbf{W}, \mathcal{D})$.

nodes.name: Lemma 47
nodes.statement: Let $\mathbf{X}$ and $\mathbf{Z}$ be disjoint node sets in an MPDAG $\mathcal{G}$, let $\mathbf{X'} \subseteq \mathbf{X}$, let $\mathcal{D}$ be a DAG in $[\mathcal{G}]$, and let $\overline{p}$ be a path in $\mathcal{D}_{\overline{\mathbf{X}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}$. If the path in $\mathcal{G}$ corresponding to $\overline{p}$ is of definite status, then the sequence of nodes in $\mathcal{G}_{\overline{\mathbf{X'}}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}}$ corresponding to $\overline{p}$ forms a path where a node is a definite non-collider or collider if and only if it is a non-collider or collider, respectively, on $\overline{p}$.
